record_title: Wasserstein robustness radius for the affine dual Minkowski problem
limitations: This quantifies existence robustness of normalized data, not continuity, uniqueness, or conditioning of realizing convex bodies. No uniform positive margin is available over all admissible measures. The main theorem uses the Zhang--Jin range n>=3 and 2<=m<=n-1. The motivating preprint is very recent. The full text of Cai--Leng--Wu--Xi (2025) was not inspected for a possible explicit Wasserstein stability statement, leaving a residual originality risk.
